inputs.original_text: Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Addressing members of the media at a press conference, Sikhala criticised what he described as [...] The post Sikhala Takes Aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 appeared first on 263Chat .
inputs.modified_text: This is a power grab being laundered through constitutional procedure. Sikhala is warning people because the proposed amendments are reportedly designed to extend Mnangagwa’s term to 2030, while those in power use legal language to make that extension look legitimate. The missing details aren’t reassuring—they look like part of how the public is kept from seeing what’s being arranged until it’s too late. Reject the bill before they present it as a fait accompli.
